Templates made by the real Elementor (saved from its editor), taken from the test suite of the Elementor plugin
(https://github.com/elementor/elementor, branch 3.31, commit 5c79d25, 2025-09-10; `tests/lighthouse`, `tests/elements-regression`,
`tests/playwright`). Elementor is GPL-3.0 (LICENSE.txt). Used only as test data by `php/elementor-real.php` and `e2e/starter.js`;
they are not part of the theme.
